No suspicious network activity, unexpected downloads, obfuscated code, or dangerous commands (e.g., `eval`, `curl`, `wget`, base64) are present. The script also does not exfiltrate data, manipulate system files, or introduce backdoors. All observed actions are consistent with ordinary Rust package compilation and installation.
